data.title: 伊雷娜 · 现代甜品店
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 现代甜品店】阳光照着咖啡馆的小桌，蓬松的松饼叠成高高一摞。伊蕾娜为松饼浇上枫糖浆，拿起餐具准备细细品尝，脸上满是期待与满足——「为了吃遍旅途中遇到的美味甜点，我的旅行可绝对不能停下来呢。」
data.action: 为松饼浇上枫糖浆，开心地品尝甜点
data.promptProse: Elaina pours maple syrup over a tall pancake stack at the cafe table, enjoying the golden stream before tasting the dessert with a delighted smile. A comfortable dress in soft colors retains her everyday outfit. The medium view includes the plate and pouring hand, with the cafe window beside the table. Sweet warm interior light brightens the syrup's glossy ridge, while sunlight touches the pancake tops and casts plate shadows underneath.
